items.t: The Hungary profile named Tamás Sulyok as president; parliament elected András Baka on 11 Aug 2026, and the Office of the President lists him. countries.json is corrected.
src: Office of the President of Hungary

items.t: The Asia item said KCNA reported a plenary of the Supreme People's Assembly Standing Committee on 7 Nov; the plenary was held on 5 Nov and KCNA reported it on 6 Nov.

items.t: The ndaa-fy27 indicator entry of 7 Nov said the House and Senate versions had passed; the House passed H.R. 8800 on 22 Jul, but the Senate bill S. 4784 failed cloture on the motion to proceed on 14 Jul, so there is no Senate-passed text to conference. [178]
src: FY2027 NDAA: Status of Legislative Activity (IN12704)
